test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a manufacturing unit, it was noted that the price of raw material has increased by 25% and the labour cost has gone up from 30% of the cost of raw material to 38% of the cost of the raw material. What percentage of the consumption of raw material be reduced to keep the cost the same as that before the increase?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let, the cost of the price of raw material = 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1fe462b9ed1b53c2b200786a4dccbbd54a45cb342172cd65e121d25bf64d1aa.png] 

The percentage of consumption reduced = [(172.5 - 130)/172.5] × 100

= (42.5/172.5) × 100

= 24.63...%

≈ 24.6%

∴ The consumption of raw materials be reduced by 24.6% to keep the cost the same as before the increase

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The percentage of the price of raw materials increased = 25%

The labour cost increases = from 30% of the cost of raw material to 38% of the cost of raw material

**Calculation:**

Let, the cost of the price of raw material = x

The new cost of price of raw material = 125x/100

The cost of the labour = 130x/100

The new cost of the labour = (125x/100) (138/100)

The consumption should be reduced = [(125x/100) (138/100)] - (130x/100)

= 4250x/10000

The percentage of consumption reduced = (frac{4250x)/(10000)}{(125x)/(100)×(138)/(100)}×100

= (4250x/10000) × (100/125x) × (100/138) × 100

= 1700/69

= 24.63...%

≈ 24.6%

**∴ The consumption of raw materials be reduced by 24.6% to keep the cost the same as before the increase**
